# prompts.chat dataset snapshot

The bundled prompt text is reproduced unchanged from f/prompts.chat prompts.csv, dedicated to CC0-1.0. Chinese titles, categories and summaries are local navigation labels. They are not translations of the prompt bodies.

The selected entries, original titles, source URL, snapshot date and full input CSV SHA-256 are recorded in packages/ui/src/data/prompt-library.json. The raw downloaded CSV is retained in the local release/source-evidence folder and is not required to use or rebuild the curated library.
